scripts.build: bun run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:lab: bun run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build -c vite.lab.config.ts
scripts.test: bun run wasm && cargo test --workspace && bun test tests
scripts.wasm: cargo build -p chimera-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/chimera_wasm.wasm src/wasm/chimera.wasm
